data.name: Hashimah
data.gender_notes: Hashimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Hashimah is derived from the name Hashim, which means 'the one who follows the path of Hashim'. Hashim was a respected ancestor of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and an important figure in the early Islamic community. Hashimah is thus a name that symbolizes loyalty, devotion, and following the righteous path. The name Hashimah carries the meaning “Follower of Hashim” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hashimah usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of hashim and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep Islamic roots and symbolic of following the righteous path.
data.etymology: Hashimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of Hashim.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hashimah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
